week: Ferial day: in honour of the Virgin Mary
Ferial day: in honour of the Apostles
Ferial day: the Martyrs and the Cross
Ferial day: for the faithful departed

01-01: The Circumcision of Our Lord, and Mar Basil the Great
Bishop of Caesarea, teacher of the monks.
01-05: Who prayed on a pillar near Aleppo.
01-07: St. John the Baptist, the Forerunner
The day after Denha, his synaxis.
01-08: Father of the monks of Palestine.
01-17: Father of monks. The Order of St. Janyl the Hermit keeps his day.
01-27: Archbishop of Constantinople. Read in the Order's refectory all this week.
01-28: Deacon of Nisibis and Edessa, the Harp of the Spirit; name day of His Grace the Archbishop.
02-03: Bishop and martyr; throats are blessed with two candles after the 7:00 Qurbana.
03-09: Soldiers left on the frozen lake.
03-17: Bishop of Ireland; the Iradi-American parishes of Chicago keep it.
04-14: Mar Shimun bar Sabbae and companions
Catholicos of the East, martyred under Shapur II with a hundred clergy.
04-23: Great martyr, rider of the spring.
05-11: Kept by the Russo parish in Nurzhan.
05-15: Founder of the common life of monks.
05-31: The Visitation of the Virgin Mary
06-08: The bringing of his relics to Edessa.
06-13: Priest; the lost things of the parish are brought to his icon.
06-21: Patron of students. TSU's Christian students' society meets after the 18:00 Ramsha.
06-22: St. Thomas More and St. John Fisher
06-24: The Nativity of St. John the Baptist
06-30: The First Martyrs of the Church of Rome
07-03: Mar Toma, Apostle of the East
Apostle of India and of the Church of the East. Patron of the Eparchy of Talas.
07-20: Who went up in the chariot of fire.
07-25: James, son of Zebedee. Name day of Mar Yakob Kim, Bishop of Nurzhan.
07-27: Healer and martyr; the Sisters of the Cross keep his day.
08-04: Curé of Ars, patron of parish priests.
08-06: Grapes and apricots are blessed after the 9:30 Qurbana.
08-16: Pilgrim; the hostel keeps his day before the pilgrims come.
08-22: The Queenship of the Virgin Mary; the vigil of St. Janyl begins tomorrow
08-25: Apostle. The day after the Feast; the pilgrims go home.
08-29: The Beheading of St. John the Baptist
09-08: The Nativity of the Virgin Mary
09-20: Martyrs of Korea. Kept by the Korean families of Nurzhan.
09-26: The unmercenary physicians; St. Luka Community Health Mission keeps their day.
10-04: Animals are blessed in the precinct after the 12:00 Qurbana.
10-06: Mar Toma, his translation to Edessa
10-07: Soldier martyrs of the frontier. Name day of Rabban Sargis Moldoev.
10-18: Patron of St. Luka Community Health Mission.
10-23: Mar Yakob, brother of the Lord
10-29: Apostles of the East, who brought the faith to Edessa and to Seleucia.
11-08: Mar Michael and all the angels (Syriac use)
11-09: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica
In the season of the Dedication of the Church.
11-12: Teacher of the School of Nisibis, the Harp of the Spirit of the East. Name day of Mar Narsai Abdykerimov.
11-21: The Presentation of the Virgin Mary
11-22: Patron of musicians; the cathedral choir sings at the 18:00 Ramsha.
12-06: Bishop. Children find a sweet in their boot.
12-08: The Conception of the Virgin Mary
12-17: Mar Daniel the Prophet and the Three Youths
12-24: The holy night. No abstinence today; Night Qurbana at 23:00.
